title: CalculatorEvaluationContract
description: API Contract for the high-precision backend calculator evaluation endpoint.

expression.description: Infix mathematical expression or space-separated postfix RPN token sequence.

angle_unit.description: Angular measurements unit for trigonometric scientific operations.

mode.description: Standard triggers PEMDAS Shunting Yard infix parsing; RPN runs raw postfix stack evaluation.

result.description: The highly precise computed decimal result.

stack.description: The remaining stack values. Present when mode is rpn.

400.description: Error payload indicating invalid mathematical syntax, stack underflow, division by zero, or domain violations.

message.description: A clear, descriptive error explanation suitable for non-technical user display.
